home1.text: Long day. Carol’s going to have my head for that landing.

home2.text: Ten minutes. I just need ten minutes.

keys.text: Keys on the table, like a grown-up.

photo1.text: Dad. Martin Jordan. Best test pilot Ferris Aircraft ever had.

posters.text: Every kid on the base wanted to fly. I was the one who never stopped.

window.text: Storm’s rolling in off the lake.

dad1.text: Keep your eyes on the sky, Hal. When I come around, I’ll tip my wings for you.

dad2.text: Promise. Nothing up there to be scared of.

halMemory.text: I was eight. That night I decided I would never be afraid of anything again.

hal1.text: Wh— who’s there? What is this?

light2.text: The ring has crossed the stars to find you.

light3.text: It seeks one with the will to overcome great fear.

lightAgain.text: Look inside yourself, Hal Jordan. Answer again.

halHurt.text: You’re hurt. Don’t move — I’ll get help.

halConfused.text: I can’t understand you. I don’t know what you want.

abin3.text: Now you understand me. The ring speaks every tongue.

abin4.text: It chooses those who can overcome great fear. You have that will, Hal Jordan.

abin5.text: I am Abin Sur. I guarded this sector of space. Sector two eight one four.

abin6.text: Take the lantern. Speak the oath. And be… worthy of it.

oath1.text: In brightest day, in blackest night,

oath2.text: No evil shall escape my sight.

oath3.text: Let those who worship evil’s might

oath4.text: Beware my power — Green Lantern’s light!

ringPocket.text: The power battery can be kept in the ring’s pocket dimension until it is needed.

halPocket.text: A pocket dimension. Of course there is.

halFly.text: Nothing up here to be scared of. You were right, Dad.

ringBond.text: Bearer accepted. Power reserve: twelve percent. Recharge at the power battery.

ringOnline.text: Construct interface online. The ring gives your will a shape.

ringCore.text: Warning: the vessel’s power core is failing.

ringHurt.text: Bearer injured. Raise the shield toward the threat.

ringWall.text: Barrier constructs hold for twenty seconds.

ringDone.text: Training complete. Recharge at the power battery every twenty-four hours, or when the light runs low.

ringOffline.text: Construct interface offline. Recharge at the power battery.

ringLowCharge.text: Insufficient charge. Recharge at the power battery.

ringSummons.text: Priority transmission from Oa, for the bearer of Abin Sur’s ring.

guardian1.text: Hal Jordan of Earth. The ring of Abin Sur has chosen you.

guardian2.text: Come to Oa, and learn what it is to be a Green Lantern.

ringCourse.text: Sector zero, at the centre of the universe. Course plotted. Climb, and I will take you there.

halAbin.text: Rest easy, Abin Sur. I’ll take it from here.

ringClimb.text: Altitude sufficient. Ready for the jump.

halEarth.text: Dad would have given anything to see this.

kwEarth.text: And poozer: Sector 2814 still needs its Lantern. Go home when you’re needed. The ring knows the way.

ringRoutes.text: Hyperspace routes charted: Earth and Oa. Fly high and press E to set a course.

ringHigher.text: Climb higher to make the jump.

kwBack.text: Back already, poozer? The range is yours.

ringAbin.text: Abin Sur’s remains have been carried home to Oa by the Corps.

ringOa.text: Oa. Sector zero. Central Power Battery in range: recharging continuously.

kwIntro1.text: So you’re Abin Sur’s pick. A human.

kwIntro2.text: Kilowog. Every rookie who comes to Oa comes through me, and most of them wash out. Till I say otherwise, you’re a poozer.

kwIntro3.text: Means you’re new. Means you’re mine. Targets are up. Break ’em.

kwFire1.text: Fists are for bar fights. Out there, things shoot back, and they don’t line up to be punched.

kwFire2.text: You need reach. Picture a cannon. Every barrel, every round. If you can see it, the ring can make it.

kwLive.text: Live fire, poozer. These ones bite.

kwShield.text: Shield! You’ve got one. Use it!

kwCover.text: You’re bleeding light. Get behind something!

kwRange.text: The range is yours. Come see me when you want another round.

sin1.text: Kilowog. So this is the human Abin Sur’s ring chose.

sin2.text: Abin Sur was my friend. His ring deserved better than a brawler from a backwater world.

sin3.text: Fists and cannons. Crude. A construct is a thought, held still. Watch.

sinDrones.text: Adequate. Now try it against someone who thinks.

sinEnd2.text: You fight like a man who has never once considered that he might lose.

sinEnd3.text: Fearless is not the same as wise. We will continue, rookie.

kwLikes.text: He likes you, poozer. That’s as warm as he gets.

kwGuardians.text: Now get moving. The Guardians want to see you. Their hall, out toward the battery. And don’t make me look bad.

ringHall.text: Summons received: the Guardians of the Universe. Course laid in to their hall.

gHall1.text: Hal Jordan of Earth. Stand before us.

gHall2.text: Abin Sur served the Corps since before your world raised its first city. In his last hour his ring went searching, and it found you.

gHall3.text: No human has worn the ring before. Your kind is young, and quick to fear.

sinHall1.text: Then let it pass to one who has earned it. Sector 2814 was his. It deserves more than whoever stood nearest when he fell.

gHall4.text: The ring does not choose in error, Sinestro. It sought one who could overcome great fear.

halHall1.text: I didn’t ask for this. He did, with his last breath. I’m not giving it back.

gRite.text: Abin Sur of Ungara. Your light returns to the light.

gHall6.text: Hal Jordan. Sector 2814 is yours to guard. Return to your world, and keep it.

ring2814.text: Sector 2814 assigned. Green Lantern Hal Jordan.

sinHall2.text: Wear his ring well, human. I will be watching.

ringHome.text: Course plotted: Sector 2814, Earth. Climb, and make the jump.

halBack.text: Four in the morning. The Air Force test is at nine. Three hours. I can do three hours.

ringMorning.text: Good morning, Lantern Jordan. Sector 2814: no threats detected.

vmTom1.text: Hal, it’s Tom. Where are you, man? The Air Force guys are here, the bird’s fuelled, and Carol’s doing the thing with her pen. Call me.

vmTom2.text: Okay. They scrubbed it. Hammond’s people just drove off. I don’t know where you were last night, buddy, but you’d better have one hell of a story.

vmCarol.text: Hal. It’s Carol. Come in. We need to talk.

vmLandlord.text: Mr. Jordan, Sal Delgado. Rent was due on the first. That makes two months. I need it by Friday, or I start the paperwork. Have a nice day.

halMorning.text: I flew across the universe last night. And I still can’t make a nine o’clock.

fridge.text: Ketchup. Half a lemon. Something that used to be milk.

bills1.text: Past due. Past due. Final notice.

bills2.text: The electric company has started using red ink. That seems personal.

photoMorning.text: He never missed a flight in his life.

windowMorning.text: Storm’s gone. Coast City looks like nothing happened last night.

notice.text: “Notice to pay rent or quit. Seventy-two hours.” He slid it under the door. Classy, Sal.

halDoor.text: Okay. Keys, wallet, ring. Let’s go get yelled at.

halDrive.text: Hammond came out from Edwards for this. Carol’s been chasing that contract for a year.

halFerris.text: Dad flew out of this field for twenty years. This is the first morning I didn’t want to be here.

carol1.text: You’re late, Hal. About an hour and a half late.

carol2.text: Then explain. General Hammond flew in from Edwards. His engineers stood on that runway and watched an empty cockpit for forty minutes.

carol3.text: So go on. Where were you?

carol5.text: My father hired you because of yours. I’ve covered for you every time you pulled something like this. The barrel roll at the air show. The landing last night. Every time.

carol6.text: Not this time. You’re grounded, Hal. You’re done at Ferris. Clean out your locker.

ringAfter.text: Lantern Jordan, your heart rate is elevated. No threat detected.

halAfter2.text: No job. Two months behind on rent. And a ring that talks.

halAfter3.text: You’d have laughed at this, Dad.

tomCall1.text: You’re still out there? I can see your car from the hangar, Hal. Listen. Hammond’s not flying home empty-handed. They put his own guy in the bird. Wheels up at two.

tomCall2.text: Some captain from Edwards. Never flown her. Carol signed off on it twenty minutes ago.

tomCall3.text: Go home, buddy. You don’t want to watch this.

halTest.text: She was supposed to be mine.

ringDistress.text: Aircraft in distress. One life aboard.

pilotMayday.text: Mayday, mayday, Viper One-One. Lost the left engine. I’ve got a fire light, she’s not answering. I can’t hold her.

pilotGear.text: I’m… something’s got me. I’m being carried. Gear’s down. Gear’s down!

ringField.text: Not here. Bring it over the field.

pilotDown.text: Ferris tower, Viper One-One is on the ground. I don’t… I don’t know how.

carolGL2.text: You caught a fighter jet. With your… hand.

techWreck1.text: Doctor Hammond, the general said nobody touches it till the team from Edwards gets here.

hecWreck1.text: The general says a great many things.

techThought1.text: …always was a freak. The old man only keeps him on out of pity…

hecArrive2.text: And you. Such loud thoughts, under that mask. Frightened little thoughts.

hecArrive3.text: Doctor Hector Hammond. The general’s son. The disappointment. They sent me to look at a ship in a lake last night, and it looked back.

hecArrive4.text: The pilot was so afraid. I only helped him along.

hecArrive5.text: Oh, I don’t think she will.

hecQ1.text: I can feel you aiming, you know.

hecWave.text: Listen to it. All of it.

ringProtect.text: Target is shielding himself. Break it.

hecMind1.text: No. No, I’m in now. An airfield. A little boy watching the sky. His father’s plane coming down.

sinFerris2.text: Ganthet sent me to learn how Abin Sur died. I did not expect to find his successor on his knees before a man with a swollen head.

sinFerris3.text: I said I would be watching.

sinFerris4.text: Abin Sur’s ship did not fall from the sky by chance, human. Its hold was a prison cell. The cell is empty.

sinFerris5.text: Something that hates us. Rest while you can. Your people are coming, and they should not find you here.

halGraveWay.text: All the way down the path. Under the two cypresses, by the bench.

halGrave2.text: I got fired today. Caught a jet with my hand. A guy with a big head read my mind. Long day.

halGrave3.text: There’s something out there. The one who knows says it hates us.

halGrave4.text: I used to tell you I wasn’t scared of anything.

halPilot0.text: She called at seven. She never calls at seven.

carolP2.text: The Air Force wants the test flown again. After yesterday, their man won’t go near that cockpit, and nobody else here will either.

carolP3.text: General Hammond went home without a word. His son is in an Air Force hospital, and no one will tell me why.

carolP4.text: So. You’re my pilot again. On probation. Don’t make me regret it.

carolP6.text: And whoever that was on my runway yesterday: if you ever see him, tell him thank you.

ringSinCall.text: Lantern Sinestro requests you at Abin Sur’s vessel.

sinCell2.text: Look at his ship, Jordan. Properly. Tell me what you see.

ringClueBlood.text: Organic residue. Species unknown. It is still burning.

ringClueGlyph.text: Script of Ysmault, cut into stone. It reads: rage.

halCell2.text: He wasn’t alone in there. Somebody was locked up, and they got out.

sinCell3.text: Abin Sur was carrying a prisoner to Oa. Atrocitus of Ysmault, one of the Five Inversions. The last of Sector 666, after the Manhunters came.

sinCell4.text: Machines. The Guardians’ first police, before the Corps. They killed every living thing in his sector but five. He has hated the Guardians, and every one of us who wears their light, for a very long time.

sinCell5.text: He broke out of that cell, and he killed Abin Sur. The crash only finished it.

ringTrail.text: Residue trail detected. Bearing west. Coast City.

sinCell6.text: Your city, Lantern. Lead the way.

atroSite1.text: Two of them. The Guardians’ dogs come in pairs now.

atroSite2.text: I smelled Abin Sur’s light on you, little human. I wondered who had taken it from his corpse.

sinSite1.text: Atrocitus. By the authority of the Guardians of the Universe, you are under arrest.

atroSite3.text: The Guardians. Let them come. Let them all come.

atroQ1.text: Is that the best your ring can do?

atroQ2.text: I bathed in the blood of my world. You will not stop me.

sinQSite.text: Keep him moving, Jordan. Don’t let him close.

sinQWall.text: A wall, Jordan. Let him run into it.

atroDrain.text: Your little lights. I know how to put them out.

sinDrain1.text: Your lantern, Jordan! Call it out of the pocket. Now!

atroExcavator.text: Die under the Earth you love, Korugarian.

atroBind1.text: Nothing is over. Not for me. Not for you.

sinBind2.text: I will take him to Ysmault. He can rot with the others.

halDevice.text: His machine. It was right here.

ringYsmault.text: Ysmault. Sector 666. No life signs on the surface.

sinYs1.text: The Inversions were chained here when the Manhunters had done their work. The Guardians thought it mercy.

atroYs2.text: Hear me, Lantern. The Blackest Night is coming. The dead will rise, and every light in the universe will go out.

atroYs3.text: And you, Korugarian. I see your world in chaos, and you at the heart of it. You will burn with a rage like mine.

sinYs3.text: To Oa, Jordan. The Guardians will want to see us both.

gTrial1.text: Hal Jordan of Sector 2814. Sinestro of Sector 1417.

gTrial2.text: You acted together on Earth without our leave. A Lantern keeps to his own sector. The charge is disorderly conduct.

halTrial1.text: He was right. Atrocitus was in my city. We stopped him.

gTrial3.text: You did. The prisoner is returned, and the Corps has lost no one else. The charge is set aside.

gTrial4.text: Sinestro. You will watch over Jordan’s training in the field.

sinTrial2.text: The next time we meet, Jordan, it will be on Korugar. Try not to embarrass me.
